agent-compatibility.known_good: A fresh clone documents one command, tracks every required fixture, and recovers a stale job from a receipt.
agent-compatibility.known_fail: Startup depends on an ignored local file and a process ID copied from an archived chat.

architecture-survey.known_good: A bounded caller-and-test trace proves three consumers duplicate the same state transition.
architecture-survey.known_fail: A large file is declared an architecture defect using line count alone.

cli-contract-review.known_good: Preflight is side-effect free and the command emits distinct setup-failure and product-failure receipts.
cli-contract-review.known_fail: A missing output path opens an interactive prompt after partial files have already been written.

verify-claim.known_good: Baseline and treatment use the same input, checker, environment, and explicit threshold.
verify-claim.known_fail: A source unit test is used to claim that the installed public executable starts successfully.
